## README.md
# USGS Sagebrush Conservation Design (sagebrush biome)

Sagebrush ecological integrity classes for the whole sagebrush biome of the western United
States, at 30 m, from the USGS Sagebrush Conservation Design (Doherty, Theobald, Holdrege,
Wiechman & Bradford 2022, <https://doi.org/10.5066/P94Y5CDV>):

| code | class |
|---|---|
| 1 | Core Sagebrush Area |
| 2 | Growth Opportunity Area |
| 3 | Other Rangeland Area |

Code 0 in the GeoTIFFs marks land outside the analysis and is the no-data value.

Six periods: 1998–2001, 2003–2006, 2008–2011, 2013–2016, 2017–2020, and a projection of the
2017–2020 classes to 2030–2060 under RCP8.5 climate change alone (`2030-2060-rcp85`, a scenario,
not an observation).

STAC: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-sagebrush/sagebrush-conservation-design/stac-collection.json>

## Files

- `sagebrush-conservation-design/sagebrush-conservation-design-<period>-cog.tif`: cloud-optimized
  GeoTIFF per period, WGS84, nearest-neighbour from the source CONUS Albers grid.
- `sagebrush-conservation-design/hex/period=<period>/h0=<cell>/data_0.parquet`: dominant class
  (`sei_class`) per H3 resolution 10 cell, with parent columns `h9`, `h8`, `h0`; `period` comes
  from the hive partition.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;
SELECT period, sei_class, SUM(h3_cell_area(h10, 'km^2')) AS km2
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-sagebrush/sagebrush-conservation-design/hex/period=*/h0=*/data_0.parquet',
                  hive_partitioning = true)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL;
```

The hex keeps only the dominant class per cell, so class areas from it are approximate (cells on
the edge of the analysis area lean toward Other Rangeland Areas). The STAC description carries the
exact source pixel counts per class.

## MapLibre GL JS (raster tiles via TiTiler)

The COGs are rasters, so there is no vector `source-layer`; render them through a TiTiler
endpoint with a categorical colormap:

```js
const cog = 'https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-sagebrush/sagebrush-conservation-design/sagebrush-conservation-design-2017-2020-cog.tif';
const cmap = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({1: '#1A9850', 2: '#FDAE61', 3: '#BDBDBD'}));
map.addSource('sagebrush', {
  type: 'raster', tileSize: 256,
  tiles: [`https://titiler.xyz/cog/tiles/WebMercatorQuad/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?url=${encodeURIComponent(cog)}&nodata=0&colormap=${cmap}`]
});
map.addLayer({ id: 'sagebrush', type: 'raster', source: 'sagebrush' });
```
